items.title: 長沙灣有地盤發現二戰美製燃燒式子彈 爆炸品處理課人員到場檢走
items.summary: 長沙灣有地盤發現懷疑戰時子彈，警方爆炸品處理課人員到場處理。 警方昨日傍晚6時許接獲興華街3號一個地盤的工人報案，指發現兩枚懷疑炸彈，警員接報到場，發現兩枚二戰時期美製燃燒式子彈，分別長約15及17厘米，爆炸品處理課人員到場檢走，並將兩枚子彈安全處理，事件中無人受傷。 編輯：許敬軒
items.titleEn: In Nagasaki Bay, a US-made incendiary bomb was found and explosives team arrived to check it out.
items.summaryEn: In Nagasaki Bay, a suspected wartime bomb was found and the police's explosives handling unit arrived to handle the bombing. Police received a report yesterday evening at 6pm from workers on a plot at Xinjiang 3rd Street that two suspicious bombs were found, police responded to the report, two US-made incendiary bullets of about 15 and 17 centimeters in length during World War II, and explosives handling personnel arrived on the scene to inspect and handle the two bombs safely, leaving no one injured. items.titleEn: Government: Policy Bureau is working on reviewing risk prevention and cybersecurity risks
items.summaryEn: In response to recent leaks of personal data, the government has said that it pays great attention to information and cybersecurity. The relevant policy agencies are actively reviewing the existing risk prevention mechanisms to improve their security capabilities and address the increasing cybersecurity risks. In addition, the chairman of the Civil Liberties Union and a member of the Legislative Assembly, Chen Kluth, said that over the past two months, there have been close to 20 cyber leaks in Hong Kong, affecting more than three million people. He has written to the chairman of the Security Affairs Committee of the Legislative Assembly to recommend a temporary admission to the emergency session on the 1st of next month to discuss "strengthening cybersecurity prevention and curbing the risks of fraud caused by large data breaches".
